goal: Report disk read failures and index corruption as errors instead of misreporting transactions as missing
Prevents masking underlying storage corruption when querying transactions over RPC and REST
reviewability: Ready for review and fully approved with no known blockers
agreement: Broad consensus that internal read failures must not be reported as missing transactions
Strong support for throwing errors on I/O and corruption rather than returning not found (ryanofsky)
Concerns about pruned blocks and leftover shutdown entries were addressed (yuvicc, ryanofsky, l0rinc)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because silent wrong answers and masked index corruption represent a significant data integrity hazard
Stops txindex from treating database corruption or block file read failures as nonexistent transactions

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because reporting confirmed transactions as missing on disk read failure misleads users
Ensures RPC and REST endpoints distinguish actual missing transactions from internal storage errors
